summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: continue existing read-only security evidence and failure containment; allow ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, data, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries; block public exposure, security-sensitive releases, credential or permission changes, dependency additions, deployments, and external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and failed-work containment only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release and deployment provenance, dependency controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
